title: Fast AI and Robot AI Arrive! Gemini 4 and Praxis-1

opening.say: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio. It's Friday, November thirteenth.

opening.say: Today we have five stories about AI and three D.
opening.show: Today we have five stories about AI and 3D.

news.label: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Released
points: Cuts quota use by 24% on average
details: It is optimized for coding, debugging, and agent tasks, and supports a one million token context and four levels of reasoning.
The Orchestrator added to Google Antigravity automatically switches between a high-performance model and Hydrogen within a single session.
Google's evaluation says success rates stay close to a single model's, while completion time is also cut by 19%.

lines.say: First up is Google, and the arrival of Gemini four Hydrogen.

lines.say: It's a model built for speed in everyday coding.
lines.show: It's a model built for speed in everyday coding.

link.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen

news.label: Runway Releases Praxis-1
details: The weights, along with inference and fine-tuning code, have been released under the Apache two point zero license.
It is a 27 billion parameter MoE diffusion Transformer that predicts video and robot actions together.
On NVIDIA's RoboLab-120 evaluation, it beat the publicly available models it was compared against in success rate across 1,200 episodes. Running it requires a high-performance NVIDIA GPU.

lines.say: Next, a story about robots. Runway has released Praxis one.
lines.show: Next, a story about robots. Runway has released Praxis-1.

lines.show: It's an open model that predicts video and actions together.

lines.say: It's fascinating to see knowledge about video put to work for robots.

link.title: Runway Praxis-1 Is Now Available: Open-Weight Robotics Model
link.description: Runway Praxis-1, our open-weight world action model for robotics, is now available under Apache 2.0. Download the weights on Hugging Face and GitHub.

news.label: Gemini Decisions API
points: Handles up to 1,000 decisions at once
details: For text, images, audio, video, and PDFs, it judges batches of questions such as yes or no, multiple choice, and rating scales, and returns a confidence score.
That is the typical response time published by Google. It does not generate text.
There is no charge for output tokens. It lets you build tool selection, image classification, and inspection judgments quickly and at low cost.

lines.say: Here's one more from Google, the Gemini Decisions API.
lines.show: Here's one more from Google, the Gemini Decisions API.

lines.say: It judges up to one thousand questions at once and returns a confidence score.
lines.show: It judges up to 1,000 questions at once and returns a confidence score.

lines.say: Responses in one hundred fifty to two hundred fifty milliseconds are a real draw.
lines.show: Responses in 150 to 250 milliseconds are a real draw.

link.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
link.description: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

news.label: NVIDIA Déjà View
details: It estimates camera positions and dense 3D geometry. It has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026.
It repeatedly runs the same Transformer block, which keeps the parameter count down.
You can tune it by changing the number of iterations at inference time. However, as of this check, the release of the trained weights was not yet complete.

lines.say: Now a three D research story, NVIDIA's Deja View.
lines.show: Now a 3D research story, NVIDIA's Déjà View.

lines.say: It rebuilds three D scenes from multiple photos, with just one hundred seventeen million parameters.
lines.show: It rebuilds 3D scenes from multiple photos, with just 117 million parameters.

lines.say: It's impressive how close this small model gets to much larger ones.
lines.show: It's impressive how close this small model gets to much larger ones.

source_link.title: Déjà View
source_link.description: Déjà View — a 117M-parameter looped transformer for multi-view 3D reconstruction that matches or beats >1B-parameter feed-forward baselines and exposes inference compute as a slider.

news.label: Kurabe: Japanese AI Evaluation
points: ELEMENTS launches it free of charge
details: It is an AI leaderboard for business use in Japan, available as a web service.
Based on Japanese-language and domestic business use cases, it lets you compare combinations of AI models and execution environments.
It is part of the results of a NEDO-related research project led by AIST, and field-specific evaluations for finance, manufacturing, and more are planned.
